title: Forrestal flown to Hobe Sound, reported belt suicide attempt

tellings.quote: there, he apparently, we're told, tried to hang himself with his belt.

plain: A UFO historian named Richard Dolan, speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells about James Forrestal, the first US Secretary of Defense, in 1949. Dolan says Forrestal was flown to Hobe Sound, Florida, and that there, "we're told," he tried to hang himself with his belt. Dolan tells it as part of his argument that Forrestal's downfall was linked to UFO secrets.
